errors.evidence: The chart is a donut chart with five slices representing five topics (Moive, Common, Person, Book, Sport), not six.

errors.text_span: a legend positioned to the left of the chart
errors.evidence: The legend is located in the center of the donut chart, not to the left.

errors.text_span: The slices are visually arranged in descending order of size.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in any specific order, certainly not in descending order of size. The order is Moive (41.2%), Common (14.9%), Person (30.5%), Book (9.1%), and Sport (4.3%).
The slice for "Moive" is colored light blue, not dark blue.

errors.text_span: the “Common” slice is colored light blue
errors.evidence: The "Common" slice is colored light green, not light blue. Light blue is the color for the "Moive" slice.
The value for the "Person" slice is 30.5%, not 14.9%. The value 14.9% corresponds to the "Common" slice.
The "Sport" slice is colored lavender or light purple, not light green. Light green is the color for the "Common" slice.

errors.text_span: “Topics” is colored purple and represents 30.5% of the chart
errors.evidence: "Topics" is the title of the legend, not a data category on the chart. The slice representing 30.5% corresponds to the "Person" category, which is colored pink/light red.
